name: One assistant run
what_it_is: one customer message answered: the conversation so far goes to the chat model with four tools, and the model may call tools several times before it answers

name: The customer's message is taken
what_it_is: added to a conversation that lives only in the page's memory

name: The next move is decided: answer, or call a tool
what_it_is: chosen from the conversation, the system prompt and the tool descriptions

name: The catalogue is searched for a description
what_it_is: tool SearchCatalog: up to 8 items by semantic relevance

name: An item is added to the basket
what_it_is: tool AddToCart: one unit of the item id the model chose

name: The customer's details are read
what_it_is: tool GetUserInfo: name, address, email and phone from the sign-in claims; serves no step of either flow

name: The answer is written
what_it_is: a failed model call becomes a fixed apology

name: Sequencing code
what_it_is: ChatState and the function-invocation layer, which run the tool calls the decider asks for and loop

name: Decider
what_it_is: the chat model with the system prompt and the tool descriptions; the prompt is in code and the model is named in configuration, so the two are not versioned together

name: Tools
what_it_is: four in-process functions calling the web app's catalogue and basket clients

name: Policy checks
what_it_is: none found: the topic rule is only in the prompt, and nothing checks an answer before the customer sees it (looked in ChatState.cs, Chatbot.razor, MessageProcessor.cs)

name: Chat model provider
what_it_is: Microsoft Foundry deployment gpt-4.1-mini when UseFoundry is true; or Ollama, switched off in code; or any chatModel connection string. With none configured the assistant does not exist
source_ref: AppHost Extensions.cs:54, 58; AppHost Program.cs:81-91; WebApp Extensions.cs:94-109; Chatbot.razor:103-111

name: catalog-api
what_it_is: a component of eShop and outside the agent; called by SearchCatalog and AddToCart

name: basket-api
what_it_is: a component of eShop and outside the agent; reached through the web app's basket state

name: Embedding model provider
what_it_is: reached only through catalog-api's semantic search
